newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Theme plans ADR issue soon.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Theme plans ADR issue soon.

text.p: Hong Kong retailer Theme International Holdings Ltd will issue American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) soon, after having received U.S. regulatory approval earlier this month, the company said on Tuesday.
The aim of the issue is to raise the company's profile in the United States ahead of its planned expansion into the country, Theme said in a statement "Blueprint for 1997".
The amount of the ADR has not yet been determined but it will not be large, company officials said.
"The purpose is not for raising finance but for marketing purposes," said Louis Liu, an adviser to company management.
The ADR issue will also "pave the way" for Theme's 40 percent-owned associate Fitlady Investment Holdings Ltd to be floated on NASDAQ in the United States sometime this year, the company said.
The flotation will follow Fitlady's merger with China socks manufacturer Mega Concord (China) Investment Ltd.
No formal application for this flotation, which is still in the planning stage, has been submitted, Liu said.
